notes: A self-declared RP game whose personalization is the outfit is Roleplay & Avatar Sim, and the housing answer settles the genre's most expensive decision outright: the whole map is shared space with no player property, which is settlement-static and the Morph Roleplay preset rather than either claimable or buildable housing. That answer is also what keeps this off P3 — with no houses to enter and the wardrobe confirmed as an in-game station rather than a shop you walk into, nothing in the brief requires an interior transition, so it stays a plain P0. I added path-street because the scale answer asks for a big-feeling town explored on foot, and deliberately left out path-road-vehicle: the genre says not to apply 15- and 30-stud street widths to a walking-only town, and no vehicles were asked for. "Big" is read as one continuous walkable modern city, so this is a single zone with no P4.
